mapping.draft_py:
# Haazda Officer (M20). "When this creature enters, target creature you control gets +1/+1 until
# end of turn." Bone Pit Brute's ETB pump (B2a-bone-pit-brute) with Angelheart Protector's
# "target creature you control" selector (B9-etb-target-gains-indestructible-eot).
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
    }),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]
